responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation-URL companion for the generated `csky_tables.opt` option table. This file is part of GCC’s option-documentation metadata pipeline for the C-SKY backend, intended to map any table-generated option entries such as enum-backed `-mcpu=`, `-march=`, or `-mfpu=` values to manual anchors; in this module it is currently empty because the generated table contributes no separate per-entry URL records beyond the main option definitions.
